meta.note: Weights for opportunity-scorer (Stage 1, skill 3.6). Sub-scores are 0-100; the final score is their weighted average. Tune weights and thresholds against known-good and known-bad products.

sub_score_guidance.demand_and_trend: High when BSR indicates strong, growing or stable sales velocity. Low when demand is thin or declining.
sub_score_guidance.competition_saturation_inverted: High when few entrenched sellers and room to rank. Low when many listings have thousands of reviews.
sub_score_guidance.margin_health: Driven by margin-scorer net margin: >=40% near 100, at the minimum threshold near 50, below threshold near 0.
sub_score_guidance.differentiation_potential: High when review gaps and Reddit pains point to concrete, buildable product improvements.
sub_score_guidance.operational_simplicity: High for small, light, non-fragile, non-regulated products. Low for oversize, fragile, hazmat, or compliance-heavy items.
